title: wsl-notice config
description: ~/.config/wsl-notice/config.yaml (XDG_CONFIG_HOME respected) plus config.d/*.yaml in lexical order; maps merge. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Precedence: flags, then environment (scalar keys only), then config, then defaults.

powershell_bin.description: Name (resolved only against absolute PATH entries) or absolute path of Windows PowerShell.

app_id.description: Application identity the toast is shown under. The default is the Windows PowerShell identity, which needs no registration. An unregistered identity gives no error and may show nothing.

level_prefix.description: Title prefix per level, one line of at most 16 characters. Maps merge across drop-ins; cannot be set from the environment.

duration.description: Seconds as a number from 2 to 60, a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s or m (for example 10s), or a bare number string meaning seconds. Fractions are accepted; the schema checks the 2s to 60s range for common forms and the tool checks it exactly.
